answer: Sybil defence by a capital-backed bridge bond: every agent locks a stake that a bridge contract holds through a cooldown, and its identity weight scales with that stake rather than with how many accounts it registers. An attacker who wants a nebula of fake agents must fund each one separately; reused funding is clustered and discounted toward zero. The bond is priced in saffron credits, so 10,000 sock puppets at 50 credits each tie up half a million credits at risk, far more than the single wallet they control.
